headline: AZ are 2nd, but only a quarter of a goal better than Twente
summary: AZ Alkmaar are 2nd in the Eredivisie on 20 points, but their recent results do not match the table. On Saturday they needed a late equaliser to draw 2-2 at Cambuur. Twente arrive having won 3 of their last 5 and concede just 0.77 expected goals a game, so clear chances are rare against them. Drimble reports that Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen stayed behind injured this midweek. With the bookmaker margin removed, AZ are 43.5% favourites to Twente's 31.3%, and the market rates them only about a quarter of a goal better. The goals line sits at 3.25, with Over at 47.5%.
read: Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen has been reported injured, and a 3.25 goal line points to an open game between two teams who create chances.

facts.fact: AZ Alkmaar are second in the Eredivisie with 20 points from nine games, with Twente fifth.
facts.meaning: A meeting of two of the league's top five, with AZ holding both the higher position and home advantage.

facts.fact: Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen missed their midweek European trip through injury, Dutch outlet Drimble reported on Wednesday.
facts.meaning: One key absentee: Twente's most expensive attacking option is in doubt for Alkmaar.

facts.fact: AZ are the market's favourites at 43.5% to win.
facts.meaning: Favourites, but not even a coin flip — this is priced as a genuinely close game.

facts.fact: Twente's last five matches read LWDWW.
facts.meaning: They were unbeaten in four before Saturday's home defeat to Utrecht and arrive on the better recent run.

facts.fact: AZ needed a late equaliser to draw 2-2 at Cambuur on 18 October.
facts.meaning: They dropped points to a side below them, days after losing at Feyenoord — the league position and the recent results don't quite match.

facts.fact: Twente have conceded just 0.77 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: The tightest defence in this matchup by chance quality — AZ's attack faces a side that gives up very little.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is AZ -0.25.
facts.meaning: The market rates AZ only a quarter of a goal better than Twente — a tight game with the draw very much in play.

facts.fact: AZ have created 1.84 xG per game over their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They generate chances consistently, even in the games they have not won, so the goals threat is real.

sources.fact: AZ Alkmaar are third in the Eredivisie and were held to a draw at Cambuur on October 18, dropping points just as PSV had the day before.
AZ needed a late rescue to escape defeat at SC Cambuur, drawing after having lost their previous league match.
AZ were beaten by Sunderland in the Europa League, according to a Sunderland fan photo feature recalling a narrow win over the Dutch Cup winners.
FC Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen did not travel to Gibraltar for the Conference League match against Lincoln Red Imps because of injury, Dutch outlet Drimble reports.
Erik ten Hag is now technical director at FC Twente, and this week he criticised the state of Manchester United, according to the Manchester Evening News.
